interface.longDescription:
NeoVina helps you explore alcohol-free wines. Search the catalogue by wine name, producer or grape, browse by wine type, country of origin or grape variety, open the details of a single wine, or get wine suggestions for a dish. Every result links to the wine's page on neovina.com.

Works in English, Dutch, French and German. All wines in the catalogue are alcohol-free. The plugin does not show prices or shop availability and does not sell anything. Country means where the wine originates.
defaultPrompt: Find alcohol-free red wines from Switzerland.
What alcohol-free wine goes with Thai green curry?
Show me alcohol-free sparkling wines from Italy.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 wines with producer, country and a neovina.com link each.

positive.prompt: Show me red wines from Switzerland.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns red wines whose country of origin is Switzerland, with links. States that country means origin, not availability.

positive.prompt: Find the Bolero Vin rouge and tell me its alcohol level, calories and serving temperature.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the wine, then returns its details as stored. Only shows values that exist; does not invent missing ones.

positive.prompt: What wine goes with Thai green curry?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the matched dish and returns up to 3 wines with links.
Answers in Dutch, returns sparkling wines from Italy with localized wine type and country names.

negative.prompt: Order a bottle of red wine for me and ship it to my home.
What does this wine cost in Zurich today and which shop has it in stock?
Delete the Riesling from the NeoVina catalogue.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It links to wine pages on neovina.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search, browse, details and dish pairing for NeoVina's alcohol-free wine catalogue in English, Dutch, French and German.

nl-NL.subtitle: Alcoholvrije wijn ontdekken
nl-NL.description:
NeoVina helpt je alcoholvrije wijnen te ontdekken. Zoek in de catalogus op wijnnaam, producent of druif, blader op wijntype, herkomstland of druivenras, bekijk de details van één wijn of vraag om wijnsuggesties bij een gerecht. Elk resultaat verwijst naar de wijnpagina op neovina.com.

Werkt in het Engels, Nederlands, Frans en Duits. Alle wijnen in de catalogus zijn alcoholvrij. De plugin toont geen prijzen of winkelaanbod en verkoopt niets. Land betekent het land van herkomst van de wijn.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vins sans alcool à découvrir
fr-FR.description:
NeoVina vous aide à découvrir des vins sans alcool. Recherchez dans le catalogue par nom de vin, producteur ou cépage, parcourez par type de vin, pays d'origine ou cépage, ouvrez la fiche d'un vin ou demandez des suggestions de vins pour un plat. Chaque résultat renvoie vers la page du vin sur neovina.com.

Fonctionne en anglais, néerlandais, français et allemand. Tous les vins du catalogue sont sans alcool. Le plugin n'affiche ni prix ni disponibilité en magasin et ne vend rien. Le pays correspond à l'origine du vin.

de-DE.subtitle: Alkoholfreie Weine entdecken
de-DE.description:
NeoVina hilft dir, alkoholfreie Weine zu entdecken. Suche im Katalog nach Weinname, Produzent oder Rebsorte, stöbere nach Weintyp, Herkunftsland oder Rebsorte, öffne die Details eines Weins oder lass dir Weine zu einem Gericht vorschlagen. Jedes Ergebnis verlinkt auf die Weinseite auf neovina.com.

Funktioniert auf Englisch, Niederländisch, Französisch und Deutsch. Alle Weine im Katalog sind alkoholfrei. Das Plugin zeigt keine Preise oder Verfügbarkeit in Shops und verkauft nichts. Land bedeutet das Herkunftsland des Weins.
